# Set Up 
```{r} 

sites <- get_wq_sites()

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  sf::st_bbox() %>%
  sf::st_as_sfc() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(1000)

land_barrier <- sf::st_difference(
  study_extent,
  sf::st_union(study_area)
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf()

cost_raster <- ipdw::costrasterGen(
  xymat = sites,
  pols = land_barrier,
  extent = "polys",
  projstr = sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string,
  resolution = 100
)



dist_pwr <- c(
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  1.25,
  1.5,
  2,
  2.5,
  3
)

max_rng <- c(
  5000, 
  10000,  
  15000,
  20000
)

```


# Chlorophyll-a (**MAY DROP**)

```{r}

chla_test <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  chla_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "mg/L",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

chla_test

```

```{r}
chla_ipdw <- ipdw_manual(chla_clean, cost_raster, 20000, "mean", dist_power = 1)

plot(
  chla_ipdw,
  main = "Chlorophyll-a IPDW"
)

```

# Salinity

## Eval Sensitivity
Test model sensitivity against distance power X max range interactions
```{r}
# SAL

sal_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

sal_sensitivity

# save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  sal_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "salinity_sensitivity_test.rds")
)

```

## Run model using tuned parameters

```{r}

set.seed(42) 

folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = sal_clean,
        k = 5,
        size = 5000,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

sal_stats <- ipdw_stats(
  sal_clean, 
  cost_raster, 
  folds = folds, 
  dist_pwr = .25, 
  max_range = 10000, 
  value_col = "mean")


sal_rast <- ipdw_manual(
  sal_clean, 
  cost_raster, 
  range = 10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.25
  )  

plot(sal_ipdw_surface)

```

## Save model results

```{r}
saveRDS(sal_ipdw, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_ipdw.rds"))
saveRDS(sal_surface, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_surface.rds"))

```


# Water Temp

```{r}

  water_temp,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "deg C",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

water_temp_sensitivity

# save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  water_temp_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_sensitivity_test.rds")
)

```

```{r}
water_temp <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "water_temp_proc.rds"))

set.seed(42) 

folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = water_temp,
        k = 5,
        size = 5000,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

water_temp_stats <- ipdw_stats(
  water_temp, 
  cost_raster, 
  folds = folds, 
  dist_pwr = .50, 
  max_range = 10000, 
  value_col = "mean")

table(water_temp_stats)

saveRDS(
  water_temp_stats,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_ipdw.rds")
)


water_temp_rast <- ipdw_manual(
  water_temp, 
  cost_raster, 
  range = 10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.5
  )  

plot(water_temp_rast)

saveRDS(
  water_temp_rast,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_rast.rds")
)

```

# Dissolved Oxygen (***FINALIZED****)

Test disance power sensitivity
```{r}
do <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "do_proc.rds"))


do_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  do_proc,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "mg/L",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

saveRDS(
  do_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "do_sensitivity_test.rds")
)

```



```{r}
set.seed(42) 

do_proc <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "do_proc.rds"))

folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = do_proc,
        k = 5,
        size = 5000,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

do_stats <- ipdw_stats(
  do_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  folds = folds, 
  dist_pwr = .25, 
  max_range = 10000, 
  value_col = "mean")

do_stats

do_rast <- ipdw_manual(
  do_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  range = 10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.25
  )  

plot(
  do_rast,
  main = "DP = 0.25, MR = 10 km",
  sub = sprintf(
    "MAE = %.3f | RMSE = %.3f | Bias = %.3f",
    do_stats$MAE,
    do_stats$RMSE,
    do_stats$Bias
  )
)

```

## Save model results

```{r}
saveRDS(do_stats, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "do_stats.rds"))
saveRDS(do_rast, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "do_rast.rds"))
```
